nodes.content:
# The census tracts that meet the area, with CDC/ATSDR's Social Vulnerability
# Index 2020: RPL_THEMES is the overall percentile, 0 least and 1 most
# vulnerable; CDC writes -999 where it has no value.
frame = curio_load_data("data.curio.chicago-loop-layers", part="tracts.geojson")
for column in [c for c in frame.columns if c.startswith(("RPL_", "E_"))]:
    frame[column] = frame[column].where(frame[column] != -999)
# Tell the Autark map what kind of layer this is, so it draws it as one.
frame.metadata = {"layerType": "polygons"}
return frame
nodes.goal: Load the census tracts that meet downtown Chicago, with CDC/ATSDR's Social Vulnerability Index 2020.
nodes.title: Census tracts (SVI)

nodes.content:
# Overture Maps' buildings. Autark extrudes a buildings layer by its height
# column, in metres: Overture's height, else 3.5 m a floor, else 10 m.
frame = curio_load_data("data.curio.chicago-loop-layers", part="buildings.parquet")
frame = frame[~frame["is_underground"].fillna(False).astype(bool)]
height = frame["height"].fillna(frame["num_floors"] * 3.5).fillna(10.0)
frame = frame.assign(height=height)[["id", "height", "num_floors", "class", "geometry"]]
frame = frame.reset_index(drop=True)
# Tell the Autark map what kind of layer this is, so it draws it as one.
frame.metadata = {"layerType": "buildings"}
return frame
nodes.goal: Load Overture Maps' buildings of downtown Chicago, with a height for every one.
nodes.title: Buildings

nodes.content:
# The air temperature at 2 m of SCOUT's WRF forecast at noon in Chicago on
# 2025-07-06 (17:00 UTC; the file's hours are UTC from 00:00), in degrees C, on a
# regular longitude-latitude grid over the map's area: WRF's own grid is curved,
# so each cell takes the nearest WRF point.
import numpy as np
import rasterio
from rasterio.transform import from_bounds
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

HOUR_UTC = 17
WEST, SOUTH, EAST, NORTH = -87.662, 41.859, -87.605, 41.906
CELL = 0.002

wrf = curio_load_data("data.scout.chicago-weather-2025-07-06", part="T2.nc")
lat = wrf["XLAT"].isel(Time=HOUR_UTC).values.ravel()
lon = wrf["XLONG"].isel(Time=HOUR_UTC).values.ravel()
celsius = wrf["T2"].isel(Time=HOUR_UTC).values.ravel() - 273.15

width, height = int(round((EAST - WEST) / CELL)), int(round((NORTH - SOUTH) / CELL))
xs = WEST + (np.arange(width) + 0.5) * CELL
ys = NORTH - (np.arange(height) + 0.5) * CELL
grid_lon, grid_lat = np.meshgrid(xs, ys)
_, nearest = cKDTree(np.column_stack([lon, lat])).query(np.column_stack([grid_lon.ravel(), grid_lat.ravel()]))
cells = celsius[nearest].reshape(height, width).astype("float32")

path = curio_output_file("wrf_t2_noon_2025-07-06.tif")
profile = {"driver": "GTiff", "width": width, "height": height, "count": 1, "dtype": "float32",
           "crs": "EPSG:4326", "transform": from_bounds(WEST, SOUTH, EAST, NORTH, width, height)}
with rasterio.open(path, "w", **profile) as out:
    out.write(cells, 1)
return rasterio.open(path)
nodes.goal: Map SCOUT's WRF forecast of the air temperature at noon on 2025-07-06 over downtown Chicago, as a raster.
nodes.title: Air temperature at noon (WRF)
